title: Checks and Audits on Buildings with External Cladding
what_it_is: Checks and Audits on Buildings with External Cladding

sections.label: Cladding checks and inspections questions
sections.summary: Questions asked the Minister for Home Affairs about cladding numbers, inspections, testing, audits, lift shafts, interim measures and removal timelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: asked	 the Minister for Home Affairs (a) how many buildings currently have claddings installed on their facades; (b) of these, how many have been checked and passed local inspections; and (c) whether the Ministry will consider requiring more thorough testing of all claddings, including those which will be imported in the future, in view of violations in this sector.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs other than the buildings with external cladding being tested by SCDF, whether there are and should be plans for BCA to conduct an extensive audit of all buildings with external cladding and ensure compliance of construction materials with the Fire Code.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs (a) whether SCDF's checks on buildings with non-Class "0" cladding also cover the lifts done under the Lift Upgrading Programme; (b) for buildings found with non-Class "0" cladding, what interim measures are being taken to protect the safety of the occupiers; and (c) what is the timeline given to these affected buildings to remove the unsafe claddings.

sections.label: Alubond panels not Class 0
sections.summary: Some Alubond composite panels used as external wall cladding were not of Class "0" on core standard as required under the Fire Code.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: I want to be tentative about it, because, first, the investigations have not been completed, and second, you have to be fair to the people involved.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: It appears that some of the Alubond composite panels used as cladding on the external walls of the buildings were not of Class "0" on core standard as required under the Fire Code.

sections.label: 40 affected buildings identified
sections.summary: As of 24 August, a press statement was issued and 40 affected or thought-affected buildings were identified.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: As of 24 August, we issued a press statement.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: We identified 40 affected buildings, or buildings we thought were affected.

sections.label: Twenty buildings tested, fifteen non-compliant
sections.summary: Twenty buildings have been tested so far, and composite panels of 15 were found not of Class "0" on core standard.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Twenty of these have been tested so far, and the composite panels of 15 of them have been found to be not of Class "0" on core standard.

sections.label: Safe but claddings removed by October
sections.summary: SCDF assessed the buildings as safe despite non-compliant claddings, but required removal within two months, by end of October.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Which is why SCDF said, looking at all the buildings, that is the first thing we did.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: We assessed the buildings to be safe, despite the non-compliant claddings.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: But at the same time, we required the non-compliant claddings to be removed within two months.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: So, that should be done by the end of October.

sections.label: Lift shaft panels and cladding labels
sections.summary: SCDF checked composite panels on some lift shafts meet fire safety requirements, and labels and advisories on cladding are being explored.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: A small number use composite panels as cladding on the exterior of lift shafts, and SCDF has checked that these panels meet the fire safety requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: For example, we will explore whether composite panels of different classes of flame-spread could be more clearly differentiated using identifiable labels to, for example, reduce the possibility of the wrong type of composite panels being used.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: We have also issued an advisory to all QPs and Registered Inspectors to check carefully the intended cladding's Certificate of Conformity and test reports.
